systemSec.title: Scan Control & Anti-Bounce (Cooldown)
systemSec.subtitle: Adjust delay intervals to prevent duplicate scans on physical terminals and OLED displays.
systemSec.cooldownDesc: When an operator scans a piece QR code, the terminal and API will reject any duplicate scan of that piece during this interval, showing ESPERE Xs on the OLED display.
systemSec.tickerDesc: Periodic background synchronization frequency to keep station timers consistently up to date.
systemSec.protectionDesc: In industrial operations with Wi-Fi / Bluetooth scanners, operators can accidentally trigger the laser multiple times on the same label.
systemSec.behavior1: 1st Trigger: Processes start or completion with green confirmation and buzzer beep.
systemSec.behavior2: Repeated Triggers (< {{count}}s): Immediate rejection with OLED alert ESPERE Xs and short tone.
systemSec.behavior3: Persistence: Settings are saved in the database and propagated immediately via WebSockets to all active terminals.
systemSec.dangerDesc: Clears the Kanban Board (Tracker) and real-time indicators on the Dashboard. Deletes all active Jobs, individual pieces, scans, and timestamp history.
systemSec.preservedDesc: Product lines, Routes, Process types, Stations / Scanners, Statuses, and User accounts.
